result.instructions: Polterware MCP: four tools. polter.query reads compact text: "brief <slug|path|file>" before you work on a card, node, or file (tasks, invariants, governing decisions, facts, milestone); "search <terms>" finds anything; "show <id>" opens one record; also "commits <slug>", "status", "inbox", "cards", "handoff <slug>", "structure [<path>]", "decisions", "milestones", "roadmap", and "canvas [<name|id>]" (agent-visible canvases only). polter.apply writes Work cards, Structure nodes, Decisions, and Facts as Polter text with summary and rationale (read polter.format once; pass topic for the rest). doc.upsert writes a doc with a Markdown body. Writes join this session's run; there is nothing to start or complete.
